Uses

Wall mixers for showers and baths

The same wall mixer body can run a shower or fill a bath. In a shower it is often called a shower mixer, and some people call it a wall mixer tap. Either way, it is one lever that sets both flow and temperature.

Wall mixers are plumbed into the wall before the tiles go on, so choose the mixer before the tiler starts.

Pricing

Wall mixer prices

Three end-of-line wall mixers show their price on this site: the Luxury Wall Mixer at $85 to $130 in chrome, the Malo Wall Mixer at $110 and the Exclusive Wall Mixer at $150.

The Millennium and ACL wall mixers show Enquire Now. The price is confirmed for the model and finish when you enquire.

Diverters

With or without a diverter

Wall mixer or wall mixer with diverter: what is the difference?

Wall mixerWall mixer with diverter
OutletsOne: a shower or a bath spoutTwo: for example a shower and a bath spout, or a rail and an overhead shower
How it worksOne lever for flow and temperatureThe same lever, plus a diverter that switches between the outlets
PlumbingOne outlet pipe from the mixerTwo outlet pipes from one mixer body
PriceThe lower priced of the twoCosts more than the standard version of the same mixer

A general comparison. Check each product for its outlets.

The Luxury Wall Mixer is listed in a standard and a diverter version. The Exclusive and Malo wall mixers are listed in the diverter version only. The Millennium and ACL diverter mixers have their own page.

Finishes

Finishes and plate shapes

Millennium shower mixers come in chrome, brushed nickel, matte black, gun metal, modern brass and rosa. The plate behind the lever is round on the standard models, and the SQ models have a soft square plate.

Match the plate shape to the shower and the spout: round with round, square with square.

End of line

End-of-line wall mixers and the new ranges

The Luxury, Exclusive and Malo wall mixers are end-of-line. They are sold at their current price until they are gone, and only the versions still available are listed.

For the Millennium and ACL ranges, send the product name and finish and the team confirms availability.

Combinations

Wall mixer and outlet combinations

A wall mixer does nothing on its own. In a shower, pair it with a new shower set. Over a bath, pair it with a swivel bath spout or a fixed spout in the same finish.

Some ACL wall mixers are sold as a separate in-wall body and trim kit. The body goes in at rough-in and the trim kit is fitted after tiling, so check that you have both.

Warranty

Warranty

Wall mixers carry their maker's warranty. ACL lists 8 and 20 year warranty periods on some of its wall mixers and bodies. Because the body is sealed inside the wall, the warranty depends on installation by a licensed plumber.

Collecting

Pick-up from Bonnyrigg

Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. We are open Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm. Collect the mixer with your tiles so your plumber has it for the rough-in, or ask about delivery across Sydney metro.

Construction

Brass and stainless steel construction

The Luxury range is described as solid brass with a chrome plated finish. Millennium describes its Finesa mixers as an all brass product except for the cartridge.

ACL lists SS304 stainless steel for some of its wall mixer bodies and a 35 mm cartridge on many models.

Care

Looking after a wall mixer

Wipe the plate and lever with a soft damp cloth and dry them. Do not spray cleaner behind the plate, where it can sit against the wall seal.

If the lever becomes stiff or the mixer drips, the cartridge can be replaced without removing tiles. Wall mixers are part of our range: we deliver tapware Sydney metro wide.

Wall mixers

Wall mixer questions

What is a wall mixer?

A wall mixer is a single lever tap fixed in the wall. It blends hot and cold water and sends it to a shower or a bath spout. Only the lever and plate show, and the body sits inside the wall.

What does a diverter do on a shower mixer?

A diverter switches the water between two outlets from one mixer, for example between an overhead shower and a hand shower, or between a shower and a bath spout.

Can one wall mixer run a shower and a bath?

Yes, if it has a diverter. The diverter sends water to either the shower or the bath spout. A standard wall mixer feeds one outlet only.

How much is a shower wall mixer?

The end-of-line wall mixers with a price on this site run from $85 to $150. The Millennium and ACL shower mixers show Enquire Now.

Does a wall mixer need a plumber?

Yes. A wall mixer is connected to the hot and cold water inside the wall, which is plumbing work for a licensed plumber. It is fitted before the wall is tiled.

What is a progressive wall mixer?

A progressive mixer has one control that you turn. It opens the water and moves from cold through to hot as you keep turning. There are 20 on this page.
